resolution.note: Dropped 2026-11-21 by operator order: CI Check is the only gate; tasks that add, tighten or patch a refusal are not done (see .krn/runs/prune/gates.md)

title: Context-band gate runs from the repository and measures notification cost
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-20 asked whether a 400k window with advisories at 200k is the right recipe, and asked to optimise it. The gate in t-1nkf30z is due on or after 2026-11-24.
Evidence: .krn/runs/lead/context-budget/analyze_peak.py fails with FileNotFoundError on prs2.json. The analysis lives untracked under .krn/runs, so the gate cannot run. The corpus now holds 161 lead sessions and 14959 priced turns (2026-11-09..2026-11-20). In the 2026-11-19/20 lead session, background-agent "still waiting" notifications took a large share of the lead's context.
Files: scripts/context-gate.ts (new, moved from .krn/runs), src/context/gauge.ts, src/ledger*
Outcome: `krn ledger --context-bands` fetches PR data itself and prints first-push-green and rework per context band, plus the Fisher verdict for t-1nkf30z. A second line reports the share of lead context spent on subagent notifications.
Proof: a test with a fixture corpus prints the expected bands and verdict; run on the live corpus, its output is committed into the t-1nkf30z decision.
